normal_interpolation: one common scalar interpolates each complete low-central or central-high vector; all categories and generation covary
pre1955: actual equals ordinary-cycle background; same ocean initial state in1850; calculated1955-1991 anomaly retained for1992 windows
epochs_reason: 1955 is the requested analysis start, not evidence of geological onset;1986 first retained event-plume inventory and2011 monitored Axial/Grotto era define aggregation bins, not inferred global change dates
parent_scope: reserve entire1850-2025 young generation plus initial young cohort from connected-old enthalpy before summing; conservative ownership closure, not proven shallow-rock ancestry
conduction: fixed normal supply; subtract every rerouted TW from donor; no extra unbounded conduction anomaly
global_relaxation: regional reference weights and geological supply are aggregated before optimization; global inventory closure does not establish basin-by-basin hydraulic reachability
S2_scope: outer relaxation combining separate flow and thermal limits, not a published paired60kg/s and60K run; high-state occupancy may reach1; not an empirically demonstrated global maximum
known_events: dated water inventories and mapped material remain nested constraints/evidence of the existing class; no rock inventory is converted to an extra instantaneous water pulse
unrepresented_terms: finite bounds condition on no additional unrepresented distinct deep source and zero unrepresented ocean legacy; report their coefficients separately
comparison: no fitting or actual contribution separation; original climate paths retained; any budget compatibility is separate from source bounds

field_power_evidence.scope: Local field-calibrated equivalent-cell transfer assumption, not a measured universal global cap
field_power_evidence.stress_product_limitation: 60 kg/s is exploratory net siphon transport; about60C is column-base contrast, not an explicitly paired gross outlet enthalpy measurement
